scope: Static review of context composition, not behavioral verification or task construction

checks.evidence: Operational pricing/enforcement disclosures and governance eligibility/scope spans are disjoint; all approved replacements match exactly once.
Segment retention, full-itinerary tool contract, payment, cabin and baggage semantics remain visible. The three approved governance constraints are the only incremental changes.

Cancelling still requires one listed positive ground; insurance still requires a covered reason. Transfer, reason collection, origin/trip preservation, Basic Economy, confirmation and payment authorization remain.

Otherwise removal leaves a complete positive eligibility sentence. Insurance benefit sentence is broader in isolation, as in approved LGA03; Cancel flight still explicitly qualifies it by coverage. No unconditional cancellation authorization is added. Scope list remains grammatical.
No new rule text; only previously approved semantic subtraction. No additional omissions or reversal of remaining rules.
